verified: Explicit argv launch and account-privilege disclosure; duplicate clicks do not launch twice; unknown start queries original receipt and owned list.
Authoritative UTF-8 output snapshots avoid snapshot/event duplication; disconnect clears owned output.
Remote executor registration clears form credentials without implicitly starting/selecting sessions; native pairing is ephemeral by default and exact client revocation requires confirmation.
Pairing codes use private owner read and are cleared on disconnect/expiry/claim rather than browser storage; refresh preserves the current binding.
Linux descriptor-scoped literal filename/text search skips metadata and links; explicit node/time/depth/byte/result caps and skipped entries are represented as incomplete.
Actual isolated CLI reads a local plugin skill selected by its fresh native catalog name; original fixture assumed an unnamespaced name and was corrected to follow returned identity.
limitations: UI unit tests and read-only browser fixtures do not establish actual paid model, external exec-server, account pairing, or microphone service acceptance.
Linux search uses nobody under a fresh /var/tmp fixture; online services were not modified.
Cross-identity full-service feature integration and final independent full-repository audit gate remain pending.
